instruction: Use the set square to push the three blocks into a straight, aligned row, then reset the robot arm.

arguments.note: I will orient the left hand downward to grasp the set square, leaving the cubes on the table.

arguments.note: The straightedge has reached the nearer cubes. I will advance in five-millimetre increments so their faces settle against it.
